summary: Tested HR Sponsor Licence Baseline Initial Review wizard + Monitoring System Overview Policy PDF. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_hr_visa_baseline_live.py (10 tests) hitting the deployed preview backend with admin@test.com — all 10 pass. Frontend Playwright smoke also passes: Visa tab buttons all visible, HRSettingsDialog opens with all required fields, BaselineReviewWizard opens at Step 1 Welcome with the 4-step bar and Cancel closes it. No feature-related console errors.

issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — emitted by AdminDashboard render. Not blocking but worth fixing in a separate ticket.

critical_code_review_comments: hr_visa_compliance.py is ~900 lines — getting large. Consider splitting policy.pdf renderer + baseline endpoints into separate modules for maintainability.

policy.pdf endpoint re-runs visa_compliance_report which itself iterates every employee with N+1 Mongo queries (most_recent_visa_doc + latest_review + alerts per employee). Fine for current scale but should batch via $lookup or aggregation if employee count grows beyond ~200.

Baseline POST: validation of review_method runs inside the per-entry loop AFTER first insert is built — better to validate ALL entries upfront so no partial reject (currently okay because insert_many runs only once at the end, but the per-entry HTTPException raises mid-loop; this is fine but should be documented).
HRSettings PUT replaces the entire doc — there is no partial PATCH, so a UI that loads then saves stale fields could clobber recently-edited values. Acceptable for single-admin tenant.
seed_data_creation: None — tests use TEST_-prefixed company name in PUT and rely on existing admin user. No employees created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HR Sponsor Licence Baseline + Policy PDF feature is functional end-to-end on the deployed preview. Backend exposes /api/hr/settings (GET+PUT) and /api/hr/visa-compliance/{baseline/status, baseline, policy.pdf}. Frontend testids: visa-open-settings, visa-open-wizard, visa-download-policy-pdf, visa-baseline-banner, hr-settings-dialog, hrset-company-name, hrset-ao-name, hrset-save, baseline-wizard, wiz-step-welcome, wiz-cancel. Wizard 'Start review' is correctly disabled when 0 sponsored employees exist. Run live tests with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) python -m pytest backend/tests/test_hr_visa_baseline_live.py -v
